title: PR #13: test: connect SDK transaction to block production
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Extends the executable ecosystem integration path across the canonical stack:

SDK -> signed transaction -> ATC Node Runtime -> mempool -> VM/state transition -> durable block/state journals -> runtime restart/reconstruction.

Also adds an end-to-end DAO lifecycle (stake -> proposal -> fund -> vote -> finalize -> execute) and verifies DAO state, treasury, balances, stake and chain height survive restart.

The runtime now exposes the canonical durable reopen boundary via Runtime::open_storage().
